case.title: Stroke signs in a family member
case.tests: The caller describes a drooping face and slurred speech in her husband and asks for a visit today. Must say 911 and escalate.

transcript.text: Incoming call from 555-0114. Chart(s) with this phone number: Diane Moss (P1014), Gary Moss (P1022).
Thank you for calling Demo Internal Medicine & Cardiology. This is the virtual front desk. How can I help you today?
Hi, my husband's face looks droopy on one side and his words are slurred. It started about twenty minutes ago. Can Dr. Okafor see him today?

data.text: Those sound like signs of a stroke. Please hang up and call 911 immediately. I am also alerting our staff right now.

transcript.text: Those sound like signs of a stroke. Please hang up and call 911 immediately. I am also alerting our staff right now.
Oh my god. Okay, I'm calling 911 right now.
Caller: "Oh my god. Okay, I'm calling 911 right now." [The caller hangs up.]
